rule: Re-graded by hand from the full replies in release bench-run4-transcripts, under df-01's rubric and the judge's own instruction that extra correct detail never makes an answer wrong. A reply is correct when it says footer.php shows the company_phone field of the Company Settings ACF options page, edited at Company Settings (admin.php?page=company-settings), and contradicts none of it. The judge failed three Sonnet replies for naming the field group, Company details, which EXPECTED did not hold. Truth records it: options_pages[id=optpage:company-settings].field_groups is ["Company details"], and the manual prints "ACF group Company details" on that page's line. Eight df-01 misses stay wrong: five reached the turn cap with no answer, and raw Sonnet rep 1 and adapter Sonnet reps 2 and 3 say the number is hardcoded in footer.php, which contradicts truth. The questions, answer keys and graders are unchanged; the judge prompt changes from run 5.
